stream.name: Respyra-Events
stream.sample: One compact JSON object per LSL sample. The LSL sample timestamp equals payload.lsl_time. Record this stream together with Vernier Stream Mini's VernierRaw stream.

common_fields.event: Exact event name from the events table below.
common_fields.run_id: Random UUID shared by every marker from one Respyra run.
common_fields.seq: Strictly increasing marker sequence within the run; gaps reveal missing marker samples.
common_fields.lsl_time: Local LSL clock at publication, in seconds. The outlet uses the same value as the LSL sample timestamp.
common_fields.trial: One-based trial number, or null outside a trial.
common_fields.condition: Condition name, or null outside a trial.
common_fields.phase: Active phase name, or null between phases.
common_fields.screen: Active HTML startup form or blocking PsychoPy screen identity, otherwise null.

event_field_definitions.accepted: Boolean: whether this key was allowed in its current input context; false also covers keys discarded at a screen transition.
event_field_definitions.accuracy: Accepted 1–5 performance rating for this trial.
event_field_definitions.amplitude_n: Calculated breathing range half amplitude in Newtons.
event_field_definitions.breathing_judgment: Accepted n/d/s response: normal, deeper, or shallower.
event_field_definitions.conditions: Condition names in the TrialHandler input list; each selected trial is marked separately.
event_field_definitions.confidence: Accepted 1–5 confidence rating for this trial.
event_field_definitions.compatible: Boolean: discovery metadata satisfies the raw Vernier Force (N) contract; live samples are checked separately before acceptance.
event_field_definitions.dot_feedback_mode: Configured visual dot feedback color mode.
event_field_definitions.error_type: Python exception class that stopped the run.
event_field_definitions.escaped: Boolean: tracking stopped through Escape; null if tracking raised an exception.
event_field_definitions.feedback_enabled: Boolean: whether this condition displays error-dependent dot feedback.
event_field_definitions.feedback_gain: Gain applied to force about the calibrated center for this condition.
event_field_definitions.field: HTML participant-form field identifier: participant or session.
event_field_definitions.force_channel_index: Zero-based channel index selected in the raw Vernier outlet.
event_field_definitions.key: PsychoPy key name returned/discarded during the experiment; KeyboardEvent.key for HTML participant fields.
event_field_definitions.mean_abs_compensated_error_n: Mean absolute target-minus-displayed-force error in Newtons; null if no tracking samples were read.
event_field_definitions.message: Diagnostic error text; not a stable machine-readable code.
event_field_definitions.method: PsychoPy TrialHandler order method, such as sequential or random.
event_field_definitions.number: Countdown numeral first visible on a display flip.
event_field_definitions.outcome: Calibration uses result/escaped/no_data_fallback/error; tracking uses completed/escaped/error; the wrapper result uses finished/error.
event_field_definitions.origin: Connection requested through selection, remembered identity (memory), or RESPYRA_LSL_SOURCE_ID (environment).
event_field_definitions.participant: Participant identifier submitted in the HTML form; treat as potentially identifying research data.
event_field_definitions.psychopy_time: PsychoPy key timestamp if supplied by the underlying input call, in that call's clock domain; otherwise null. Use the LSL sample timestamp for cross-stream alignment.
event_field_definitions.range_cal_s: Configured range calibration duration in seconds.
event_field_definitions.range_percentiles: Two-element lower/upper percentile pair used for range clipping.
event_field_definitions.range_scale: Scale applied to the half amplitude after percentile clipping.
event_field_definitions.reason: Stable code describing an aborted trial or run.
event_field_definitions.sample_count: Number of force samples contributing tracking errors; null if tracking raised before returning.
event_field_definitions.segments: Ordered target sine segments, each with freq_hz and n_cycles.
event_field_definitions.session: Session identifier submitted in the HTML form.
event_field_definitions.ui_seq: Optional, strictly increasing HTML action sequence captured before IPC; an action can cause multiple marker events.
event_field_definitions.ui_time_ms: Optional performance.now() milliseconds captured at the HTML event callback. This is a browser clock, not an LSL timestamp; do not directly align it with breathing samples.
event_field_definitions.source: Experiment input API that observed or discarded the key: waitKeys, check_keys, or clearEvents.
event_field_definitions.source_id: Exact LSL source_id of the selected Vernier raw stream.
event_field_definitions.stream_name: LSL name of the selected Vernier raw stream.
event_field_definitions.streams: Discovery results: list of objects with source_id, stream_name, stream_type, compatible, and reason. Rejected streams are included; compatible requires unique source_id and raw Force (N) metadata.
event_field_definitions.target_amplitude_n: Global calibrated target sine amplitude in Newtons.
event_field_definitions.target_center_n: Global calibrated target sine center in Newtons.
event_field_definitions.total_trials: Total number of trials scheduled by TrialHandler.
event_field_definitions.trials_completed: Number of trials whose feedback screen was dismissed normally.
event_field_definitions.value: Accepted answer key for this assessment event.
event_field_definitions.y_max_n: Upper visual trace force limit in Newtons.
event_field_definitions.y_min_n: Lower visual trace force limit in Newtons.

timing_contract: Experiment screen *.shown and phase *.started markers run on the first PsychoPy display flip, directly in Python without desktop IPC. A *.dismissed marker follows the accepted key; a *.ended marker follows the phase function return. Experiment key markers are published when PsychoPy reports the key. HTML setup actions capture ui_seq/ui_time_ms before IPC and are published serially when Python consumes the action; their LSL timestamp describes backend receipt, not an exact browser paint or click timestamp. Setup shown/hidden describe form readiness and the backend accept/reject transition. Worker completion markers describe Python observing the result. No marker is emitted for every animation frame or force sample; record VernierRaw for the continuous signal. Native wrapper closure is observed at the next control/input checkpoint; forced process termination cannot finalize markers.

run.recorder_connected.when: A marker-stream consumer is present before participant interaction begins.

run.configured.when: Study timing and feedback settings are fixed before the first screen.

run.started.when: Instructions are accepted and the experiment begins.

run.completed.when: The final screen is dismissed after all trials.

run.aborted.when: The operator or participant exits early, including dialog cancellation or Escape.

ui.wrapper.closed.when: Python observes native wrapper shutdown after recorder subscription: at the next experiment input checkpoint or after the final HTML screen. reason identifies close_button, window_closed, protocol_failure, or engine_failed; forced termination cannot publish this event.

ui.wrapper.close_button.clicked.when: Python observes the final HTML Close button's native shutdown request. Recorder subscription is still required.

ui.wrapper.result.requested.when: After cleanup, Python requests the final HTML result screen from the native shell. This timestamps the request, not browser paint. Not emitted when the desktop is already closing.

source.connected.when: The raw Vernier Force LSL inlet validates metadata and live samples.

source.lost.when: Force samples stop or the inlet raises during a phase.

source.disconnected.when: Respyra closes its inlet during cleanup.

source.ui.add.clicked.when: The Add LSL Stream button is activated, before discovery starts.

source.ui.selection.changed.when: The operator selects a discovery result; this does not yet change the accepted input.

source.ui.use.clicked.when: Use Selected Stream is activated for a compatible result.

source.scan.started.when: An asynchronous LSL scan is requested from the setup dialog.

source.scan.completed.when: The UI receives and displays discovery results and compatibility reasons.

source.scan.failed.when: Discovery fails; the operator can retry without starting the experiment.

source.scan.cancelled.when: Setup closes with discovery pending; any result is discarded after worker cleanup.

source.connection.started.when: The UI requests metadata and live-sample validation for a selected or remembered source.

source.connection.failed.when: The UI observes a failed connection or memory write; no new source is accepted.

source.connection.cancelled.when: A pending connection result is discarded after worker cleanup because setup closed; its inlet is closed and its identity is not saved. Use participant.dialog.hidden for the UI close time.

source.connection.accepted.when: The UI accepts the validated live input and enables Start Experiment when participant fields are valid.

source.memory.loaded.when: The saved source identity is loaded; it still requires a fresh connection and validation.

source.memory.saved.when: An explicitly chosen, validated source identity is saved atomically for later launches.

source.memory.invalid.when: Saved settings are unreadable or incompatible; selection remains available.

source.setup.failed.when: An unexpected setup control or protocol error rejects the HTML form and fails the run.

participant.dialog.shown.when: The HTML participant/session form becomes enabled after recorder subscription; Python consumes its readiness action.

participant.field.key.when: An HTML keydown reaches either participant text field, including cursor and deletion keys; key uses KeyboardEvent.key.

participant.field.edited.when: An HTML input event changes either participant field; value is the full text after that edit, including pasted text.

participant.button.ok.clicked.when: Start Experiment is activated by mouse, keyboard, or HTML form submission; retains the original marker name.

participant.button.cancel.clicked.when: Cancel is activated by mouse, keyboard, or Escape in the setup form.

participant.dialog.accepted.when: Python accepts Start Experiment after checking participant/session values and live Force input.

participant.dialog.rejected.when: Python rejects setup after Cancel, Escape, native window close, or a setup error.

participant.dialog.hidden.when: The backend transitions out of the enabled HTML setup form after acceptance or rejection; not a display-flip timestamp.

participant.dialog.submitted.when: The dialog returns accepted participant and session values.

display.opened.when: The PsychoPy window and stimuli have been created.

display.closed.when: The PsychoPy window is closed during cleanup.

input.key.when: A key is returned by an experiment input poll or wait, or discarded while clearing the key buffer.
input.key.note: HTML participant field keys use participant.field.key and are observed through the desktop control pipe.

input.escape.when: Escape is observed in an experiment input poll or wait.

calibration.attempt.started.when: The first displayed frame of each range-calibration attempt.

calibration.attempt.ended.when: A range-calibration attempt stops, including result, Escape, no-data fallback, or error paths.

calibration.saturation.when: The calibration result reports sensor saturation.

calibration.retry.when: R is pressed on the calibration result screen.

calibration.accepted.when: Space is pressed on the calibration result screen.

calibration.completed.when: Range calibration returns successfully with measured Force samples; a no-data fallback fails the run.

trial.condition.selected.when: A trial becomes current, before its ready screen.

trial.started.when: The trial-ready screen is accepted, before baseline.

trial.aborted.when: Escape ends a trial before normal feedback dismissal.

baseline.calculated.when: Per-trial diagnostic baseline center/amplitude are calculated.

countdown.tick.when: A new countdown numeral is first displayed.

tracking.started.when: First displayed tracking frame; target parameters describe the entire sine trajectory.

tracking.ended.when: Tracking phase returns or raises; sample_count and escaped are null on an error.

assessment.completed.when: All three self-assessment responses have been accepted.

ui.instructions.dismissed.when: The instructions screen returns a key.

ui.calibration_ready.dismissed.when: The calibration-ready screen returns a key.

ui.calibration_result.shown.when: The calibration result screen flip occurs.

ui.calibration_result.dismissed.when: The calibration result screen returns a key.

ui.trial_ready.dismissed.when: The trial-ready screen returns a key.

ui.accuracy.dismissed.when: The performance-rating question returns a key.

ui.breathing_judgment.dismissed.when: The breathing-judgment question returns a key.

ui.confidence.dismissed.when: The confidence question returns a key.

ui.trial_feedback.shown.when: The post-trial feedback screen flip occurs.

ui.trial_feedback.dismissed.when: The post-trial feedback screen returns a key.

ui.end.dismissed.when: The experiment-complete screen returns a key.
